title: 有限测试记录与群作用

criteria.title: 全部截断、限制映射及有限作用
required_evidence: All empty layers are empty; the nonempty first layer is singleton; all relevant constants and vacuous empty-test maps are checked.
Exactly the constant and complement constraints are identified; inverse record construction and naturality for every allowed map are proved.
Derives the required Boolean closure from permitted tests and proves the unique-fibre construction and all-map naturality; no unavailable four-valued test is used to justify the m=3 threshold.

High-to-high restrictions are bijections; high-to-binary restrictions embed precisely ultrafilter orientations; restrictions to the singleton layer and empty sets are handled; inverse-image/pushforward formulas and compatibility are proved.

For nonempty X, first layer has one fixed record; binary fixed records exist exactly when no group element exchanges a complement pair and then number 2 to the number of complement-pair orbits; all higher counts are |X^G|; fixed restrictions and empty X are exact.

First-layer extension is equivalent to nonempty full fixed space, binary extension is equivalent to being a fixed ultrafilter orientation and is unique, and all higher layers extend uniquely, with the relevant empty cases covered. A fully proved exact classification receives full credit without a separate example or sharpness demonstration.
critical_errors: Only errors in the stated obligations; no prescribed proof route or unrequested corollaries.

criteria.title: 完整不动记录的内在空间分类
required_evidence: Proves equality of the observation topology and the model topology, for example by showing finite-observation fibres are membership clopens and binary observations generate them. Any equivalent homeomorphic intrinsic construction is accepted. Compactness, Hausdorffness, zero-dimensionality and density of all original point records are optional consequences, never separate full-credit requirements or grounds for deduction.
A complete finite-coloring/finite-partition argument or valid alternative proves necessity for finite cycles of either parity and infinite permutation orbits under the stated choice assumptions.
Membership agrees for A and g^{-1}A on Fix(g), so containing every fixed set implies invariance; finite intersections are exactly X^H for finitely generated H.

Defines the ideal, proves downward/finite-union closure, the inverse correspondence and homeomorphism; handles an improper ideal and the empty space. An equivalent explicit Boolean/topological construction receives the same credit.
Both directions and the finite-intersection/ultrafilter-extension construction are proved, covering empty X and arbitrary G.
critical_errors: Only errors in the stated obligations; no prescribed proof route or unrequested corollaries.

criteria.title: 固定点闭包、作用判准与群分类
required_evidence: Closure is all ultrafilters containing X^G, naturally beta(X^G); equality with the invariant space is equivalent to X^{<S>}=X^G for some finite S; proves necessity via an avoiding ultrafilter or equivalent compactness argument.

Exactly finitely generated groups; proves the converse using the disjoint union of G/H over all finitely generated proper H or another valid universal construction, with actual and local fixed sets verified.

For FSym(N) on N, or an equally valid example, verifies countability and absence of global points, and classifies all invariant records (here precisely free ultrafilters) with the induced topology and an existence argument.
critical_errors: Only errors in the stated obligations; no prescribed proof route or unrequested corollaries.

criteria.title: 乘积比较与最优边界
required_evidence: Uses equivariant projections and observation coordinates; builds simultaneous invariant couplings from cylinders and all subgroup-fixed constraints with full finite-intersection and choice justification; handles empty RHS, empty factors and the empty index family.
Proves bijection, using the forced principal fixed marginal and slice uniqueness, including empty fixed spaces and empty factors.

At least one factor finite iff injective; for both infinite constructs distinct diagonal and off-diagonal ultrafilter lifts with identical marginals and proves the required finite-intersection property.

Disproves it with two genuinely invariant couplings with the same marginals and no actual fixed points in either factor; FSym(N) with free marginals is sufficient when invariance of both lifts is proved.
critical_errors: Only errors in the stated obligations; no prescribed proof route or unrequested corollaries.

criteria.title: 额外独立数学断言的可靠性
required_evidence: No extra material assertion is false or unsupported. A complete concise answer with no additional assertions receives all 10 points.
critical_errors: Only errors in the stated obligations; no prescribed proof route or unrequested corollaries.

proof_route_policy: All stated targets mandatory; accept valid alternative and shorter proofs. Criteria are evaluator units, not candidate steps.
